description: ### 1. You have to follow both the global ⁠<#1496730757375332473> and channel-specific rules
Ignorance of the rules is not an excuse; we expect you to have read them.
### 2. You must not ask for support in any non-support channels
Support channels include ⁠<#1496732120511414332>. Make sure to also read ⁠the <#1496735924250480650> before seeking support.
### 3. You must use the English or Hindi language
Some exceptions may be granted to non-conversational use and specific support cases.

### 4. No sharing of 3rd-party repository links or APKs
Third-party repository and apps are not affiliated with us in any way, are not supported here, and their security cannot be guaranteed. This also applies to DMing Staff.
### 5. Follow the [community guidelines](<https://discord.com/guidelines>) set by Discord
We didn't make these rules but we will enforce them, we don't make exceptions for anyone.
### 6. Spoilable content needs to be marked with context
Not everyone's definition is the same, you can read ours by using the `!spoilers` tag.
### 7. Do not advertise unprompted
This includes posting server invites, advertisements, etc. without a staff member's permission. This also includes DMing fellow members.
### 8. No impersonation
Do not pretend to be someone else, especially members with roles.
### 9.  Use common sense, and don't behave poorly
This includes but is not limited to, spamming, user mistreatment, DM/pinging unnecessarily, not listening to staff, disguising links, using pejoratives, and more.
### 10. No politics
"There is a time and place for everything, but not here." - Professor Oak.
**Does something suddenly not work?**
**Nothing in the above channels about your issue?**
**If you notice someone breaking the rules, please report it!**
• Use `!report` followed by a message. Tag the offender, provide a reason and potentially a link to the post, or a timestamp.
`(Reports get deleted instantly in the channel)`
Example: `!report @Mention is breaking Rule 6! [link_to_post]`
• If it needs urgent and immediate attention (spammer, e.g.), ping Staff and do a `!report`
